notes.title: Ping channel members regardless of global online state
notes.raw_title: fix(chat/push): ping channel members regardless of global online state
notes.summary: Regular-channel push routing dropped anyone whose global lastSeenAt was under 60 seconds old. Because lastSeenAt updates on any app-open activity (foreground poll, other-channel view, presence heartbeat), having the app open **anywhere** counted as read-receipt for **every** channel simultaneously, silently dropping push + SMS for messages in channels the user was not actively viewing.
notes.author: vectordev2001
